_meta.title: Claim <-> Findings Referee-Proofing Ledger
_meta.purpose: Audit every load-bearing thesis claim against its ACTUAL regression finding; set the thinnest referee-proof version of each. This ledger sets the claim ceiling the prose rewrite (starting at 2.1) is allowed to motivate.
_meta.governing_rule: Claim <= what the findings fully + referee-proof support. Where they do not, claim shrinks to the thinnest defensible version. Priority = complete, cohesive, coherent across all prose AND findings -- NOT impressive.
_meta.evidence_source: docs/Thesis/_tables_from_bible.tex (byte-exact copies from the bible); read in full 2026-06-12. All coefficients below are verbatim from that file.
_meta.numbers_are_locked: Coefficients are NOT changed here. Prose claims may be thinned. Risks that live in the estimation itself (one-tailed, clustering, generated regressand) are flagged as RERUN-class for user decision -- not fixable by prose.
_meta.significance_legend: * p<.10, ** p<.05, *** p<.01; n.s. = not significant
_meta._advisor_correction_2026_06_12: Advisor double-check INVERTED the C6 call: 'survives a formal test' is ACCURATE (tab:empire_cashspec is two-tailed, diff p=.039 at 5%), NOT an overclaim; the side-by-side replacement first proposed is the Gelman-Stern fallacy (referee bait). C6, the retracted-overclaim block, and the thin-claim ceiling are corrected accordingly. The 'timing vs cash' framing was a FALSE FORK -- RESOLVED 2026-06-12: BOTH dimensions (anticipatory x cash-concentrated), both in title L18, both supported.

claims_ranked_strong_to_fragile.claim: The cash-stock difference in the run-up survives a formal test (cash-specificity).

finding.CAUSE_diff_matched: 0.0064 (SE 0.0071) n.s. -- the cash build-up itself is NOT cash-specific

claims_ranked_strong_to_fragile.referee_proof: VALID at 5% (two-tailed). CORRECTED 2026-06-12 (advisor) -- I had this backwards.
risks: the EFFECT test is sound: cashspec table is TWO-TAILED (note L274), diff 0.0983 SE 0.0476 -> p=.039, significant at 5%; 'survives a formal test' is ACCURATE, not an overclaim
real fragility is the imprecise stock arm (-0.0524 n.s., SE 0.0436); body already discloses 'supportive rather than definitive' (L46) -- keep that hedge
the proposed CAUSE leg fails (0.0064 n.s. matched) -> the war-chest mechanism is NOT established; keep mechanism OPEN

DO NOT replace the formal test with the side-by-side 'sig for cash / n.s. for stock' -- that is the Gelman-Stern fallacy (difference between sig and not-sig is not itself sig) and INCREASES referee exposure
claims_ranked_strong_to_fragile.thinnest_claim: KEEP the formal interacted test as the cash-specificity claim (valid at 5%, two-tailed). Disclose its fragility (imprecise stock arm) as the body already does. SEPARATE the EFFECT (cash-specific, p=.039 -- claim it) from the CAUSE (cash build-up NOT cash-specific, 0.0064 n.s. -- mechanism stays open). Rerun that matters: two-way clustering (firm x quarter, as EPU tables already use) could STRENGTHEN it.

thin_claim_ceiling.statement: A within-firm, correlational pattern: residual CEO Q&A uncertainty is elevated in the pre-announcement quarter of cash acquirers (not detectable for stock), resolves at announcement, while the acquirer's cash persists to completion -- read as call language tracking the deal's disclosure state. NO tested mechanism, NO identification. Cash-specificity of the EFFECT IS claimable (C6 valid at 5%); cash-specificity of the CAUSE is NOT (mechanism stays open).
thin_claim_ceiling.register_that_stands: correlational / no-identification / supportive-not-definitive / mechanism-open. This part is decided.
thin_claim_ceiling.demoted: C5 convergent validity -> LEAD with the significant association (FD override 2026-06-14; was 'consistent with'); C7 presentation -> texture or drop.

RESOLVED_both_2026_06_12.decision: BOTH -- the fork was a FALSE dichotomy (user). The claim is ONE signal with TWO dimensions: ANTICIPATORY (timing: appears pre-announcement, gone at announcement -- C1) AND CASH-CONCENTRATED (cash vs stock -- C2 + C6). Not rivals; the two coordinates of the same signal.
RESOLVED_both_2026_06_12.both_in_the_title: Title L18 'Cash Got Your Tongue? CEO Language Uncertainty Around Undisclosed Cash Acquisitions' = cash (Cash Acquisitions) + timing (Around Undisclosed). Abstract L27 already says 'an anticipatory, cash-deal-concentrated component.'
RESOLVED_both_2026_06_12.both_supported: Timing (C1) strongest; cash run-up (C2) solid; formal cash-specificity (C6) valid at 5%.
RESOLVED_both_2026_06_12.hedge_that_STAYS: 'Both supported' does NOT drop the calibrated hedges on the cash leg: concentration-not-strict-specificity, supportive-not-definitive (imprecise stock arm), mechanism/cause OPEN (cause leg 0.0064 n.s.).
